user_question: Count hospitals by census tract in Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Count hospitals by census tract in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Convert hospital coordinates to spatial points
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a GeoPackage point layer from the hospital CSV using the observed coordinate fields.
workflow_steps.instructions: Convert the CSV table to point features using LONGITUDE as the longitude field and LATITUDE as the latitude field. Do not infer a source CRS if it is not explicitly available; runtime QC must obtain or confirm the CRS before conversion.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon count of hospitals for each census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital point features within each census tract polygon. Preserve the tract attributes and write the hospital count to an output field. Runtime QC must verify CRS compatibility and valid geometries before execution.

requirements.scope: Hospital coordinate table must contain the observed coordinate fields required for point construction.
The hospital coordinate table must have an explicitly confirmed source CRS before coordinates are spatialized.
Both the hospital point layer and census tract layer must have CRS metadata before spatial counting.
Hospital points and census tract polygons must use compatible CRSs for the point-in-polygon count.
Hospital point geometries and census tract polygon geometries must be valid for spatial counting.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Conversion Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Converts supported artifact representations without changing the analytical meaning of the data. CSV-to-points requires explicit coordinate-field names and a source CRS.

skills.name: Format and Spatial Conversion
skills.description: Converts data formats between GeoJSON and GeoPackage, spatializes coordinate tables into vector point layers, and exports tabular data.

other: The service does not fabricate missing records or infer unknown CRS definitions.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
